description: Source code for distributed communication operations in PyTorch, including broadcast and gradient retrieval functions.

classes.name: BroadcastWork
classes.description: Handles the broadcast operation for a set of tensors within a process group.

methods.name: BroadcastWork::finish
methods.description: Completes the broadcast operation and copies the data back to the original tensors.

methods.name: broadcast_coalesced
methods.description: Performs coalesced broadcast of tensors across processes.

methods.name: GradBucket::getGradients
methods.description: Retrieves gradient tensors from the buffer based on stored offsets and sizes.
